'''Section Desh-32''' was located onboard the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] ''[[Mantan Wanderer]]'', positioned aft and below the [[Medical bay/Legends|sick bay]] and forward from the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]]. Section Desh-32 was the home barracks for [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] unit [[Team 19]], allowing them to fulfill their secondary duty as security forces or repel boarders.<ref name="ROE" />
